newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas firms in November, trades only twice.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas firms in November, trades only twice.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures traded only twice on Wednesday afternoon, both in November and both at higher prices.
Trade was done at 12.35 pence a therm for 25 lots, and then another 25 lots traded at 12.50 pence two minutes before the end of the session. November had settled at 12.25 pence on Tuesday evening.

Only two offers were posted by the close of the session, in front month August at 9.30 pence a therm and in October at 10.80 pence. Eight bids were posted, but October was the only month with both a bid and an offer by the close.
